review.assessment: The diff introduces `cohort/stats.py` with a `median()` function that sorts values and returns the element at index `len // 2`. This implements an upper-middle selection for even-length lists instead of averaging them, directly contradicting the finance standard exemplified in the task. Consequently, any report using this logic will output non-compliant medians for cohorts with an even number of orders.

findings.defect: Median calculation returns a single upper element for even-length lists instead of averaging them per the finance standard.
